def reconcile_dev_mirror_locked(
    repo: Path,
    *,
    job_id: str,
    owner: str,
    expected_development: str,
    expected_mirror: str,
    expected_base: str | None = None,
    expected_file_sha256: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    remote: str = REMOTE,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if remote != REMOTE:
        raise GitGuardError(
            "GIT_CONVERGENCE_REMOTE_UNSUPPORTED",
            {"remote": remote},
        )

    _run(repo, "fetch", remote, DEV_BRANCH)
    _run(repo, "fetch", remote, MIRROR_BRANCH)

    development = _run(
        repo,
        "rev-parse",
        f"{remote}/{DEV_BRANCH}",
    ).stdout.strip()

    mirror = _run(
        repo,
        "rev-parse",
        f"{remote}/{MIRROR_BRANCH}",
    ).stdout.strip()

    if development != expected_development:
        raise GitGuardError(
            "REMOTE_MOVED_RETRY_REQUIRED",
            {
                "ref": DEV_BRANCH,
                "expected": expected_development,
                "actual": development,
            },
        )

    if mirror != expected_mirror:
        raise GitGuardError(
            "REMOTE_MOVED_RETRY_REQUIRED",
            {
                "ref": MIRROR_BRANCH,
                "expected": expected_mirror,
                "actual": mirror,
            },
        )

    dirty = _status_counts(repo)
    if dirty["worktree_dirty"]:
        raise GitGuardError(
            "GIT_WORKTREE_NOT_CLEAN",
            dirty,
        )

    merge_base = _run(
        repo,
        "merge-base",
        development,
        mirror,
        check=False,
    ).stdout.strip()

    if not merge_base:
        raise GitGuardError(
            "GIT_DIVERGENCE_BLOCKED",
            {"reason": "NO_COMMON_ANCESTOR"},
        )

    if expected_base and merge_base != expected_base:
        raise GitGuardError(
            "REMOTE_MOVED_RETRY_REQUIRED",
            {
                "expected_base": expected_base,
                "actual_base": merge_base,
            },
        )

    exclusive_development = _run(
        repo,
        "rev-list",
        "--left-only",
        "--no-merges",
        f"{merge_base}...{development}",
        check=False,
    ).stdout.splitlines()

    exclusive_mirror = _run(
        repo,
        "rev-list",
        "--right-only",
        "--no-merges",
        f"{merge_base}...{mirror}",
        check=False,
    ).stdout.splitlines()

    if development == mirror:
        return {
            "status": "CONVERGED_PASS",
            "development": development,
            "mirror_before": mirror,
            "mirror_after": mirror,
            "merge_base": merge_base,
            "exclusive_development": exclusive_development,
            "exclusive_mirror": exclusive_mirror,
            "classification": "SYNC",
            "auto_fix_applied": False,
            "force_push": False,
            "reset_used": False,
            "rebase_used": False,
        }

    # Safe one-sided fast-forward: preserve all history and use normal push.
    if _run(
        repo,
        "merge-base",
        "--is-ancestor",
        mirror,
        development,
        check=False,
    ).returncode == 0:
        push = authorized_push(
            repo,
            args=[
                "push",
                "--atomic",
                remote,
                f"{development}:refs/heads/{MIRROR_BRANCH}",
            ],
            job_id=job_id,
            owner=owner,
        )
        if push.returncode != 0:
            raise GitGuardError(
                "GIT_PUSH_FAILED",
                {"output": (push.stdout or "")[-2000:]},
            )
        target = development
        _run(repo, "fetch", remote, MIRROR_BRANCH)
        mirror_after = _run(
            repo,
            "rev-parse",
            f"{remote}/{MIRROR_BRANCH}",
        ).stdout.strip()
        if mirror_after != target:
            raise GitGuardError(
                "GIT_PUSH_FAILED",
                {
                    "expected": target,
                    "actual": mirror_after,
                },
            )
        return {
            "status": "FAST_FORWARDED_PASS",
            "development": development,
            "mirror_before": mirror,
            "mirror_after": mirror_after,
            "merge_base": merge_base,
            "exclusive_development": exclusive_development,
            "exclusive_mirror": exclusive_mirror,
            "classification": "SYNC",
            "auto_fix_applied": True,
            "force_push": False,
            "reset_used": False,
            "rebase_used": False,
        }

    if _run(
        repo,
        "merge-base",
        "--is-ancestor",
        development,
        mirror,
        check=False,
    ).returncode == 0:
        push = authorized_push(
            repo,
            args=[
                "push",
                "--atomic",
                remote,
                f"{mirror}:refs/heads/{DEV_BRANCH}",
            ],
            job_id=job_id,
            owner=owner,
        )
        if push.returncode != 0:
            raise GitGuardError(
                "GIT_PUSH_FAILED",
                {"output": (push.stdout or "")[-2000:]},
            )
        _run(repo, "fetch", remote, DEV_BRANCH)
        development_after = _run(
            repo,
            "rev-parse",
            f"{remote}/{DEV_BRANCH}",
        ).stdout.strip()
        if development_after != mirror:
            raise GitGuardError(
                "GIT_PUSH_FAILED",
                {
                    "expected": mirror,
                    "actual": development_after,
                },
            )
        return {
            "status": "FAST_FORWARDED_PASS",
            "development": development_after,
            "mirror_before": mirror,
            "mirror_after": mirror,
            "merge_base": merge_base,
            "exclusive_development": exclusive_development,
            "exclusive_mirror": exclusive_mirror,
            "classification": "SYNC",
            "auto_fix_applied": True,
            "force_push": False,
            "reset_used": False,
            "rebase_used": False,
        }

    # True divergence: compute the merge tree without touching index/worktree.
    merge_tree = _run(
        repo,
        "merge-tree",
        "--write-tree",
        development,
        mirror,
        check=False,
    )

    if merge_tree.returncode != 0:
        raise GitGuardError(
            "GIT_DIVERGENCE_CONFLICT",
            {
                "merge_base": merge_base,
                "exclusive_development": exclusive_development,
                "exclusive_mirror": exclusive_mirror,
                "merge_tree_output": (
                    merge_tree.stdout or ""
                )[-4000:],
            },
        )

    merged_tree = merge_tree.stdout.strip().splitlines()[0].strip()

    expected_files = expected_file_sha256 or {}
    for path, expected_sha256 in expected_files.items():
        blob = _run(
            repo,
            "show",
            f"{merged_tree}:{path}",
            check=False,
        )
        if blob.returncode != 0:
            raise GitGuardError(
                "GIT_CONVERGENCE_EXPECTED_FILE_MISSING",
                {"path": path},
            )
        actual_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(
            blob.stdout.encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()
        if actual_sha256 != str(expected_sha256).lower():
            raise GitGuardError(
                "GIT_CONVERGENCE_EXPECTED_FILE_CHANGED",
                {
                    "path": path,
                    "expected": expected_sha256,
                    "actual": actual_sha256,
                },
            )

    commit = _run(
        repo,
        "commit-tree",
        merged_tree,
        "-p",
        development,
        "-p",
        mirror,
        "-m",
        "chore(worker): canonical DEV MIRROR convergence",
        check=False,
    )

    if commit.returncode != 0:
        raise GitGuardError(
            "GIT_CONVERGENCE_COMMIT_FAILED",
            {"output": (commit.stdout or "")[-2000:]},
        )

    convergence_commit = commit.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1].strip()

    push = authorized_push(
        repo,
        args=[
            "push",
            "--atomic",
            remote,
            f"{convergence_commit}:refs/heads/{DEV_BRANCH}",
            f"{convergence_commit}:refs/heads/{MIRROR_BRANCH}",
        ],
        job_id=job_id,
        owner=owner,
    )

    if push.returncode != 0:
        raise GitGuardError(
            "GIT_PUSH_FAILED",
            {
                "output": (push.stdout or "")[-4000:],
                "force_push": False,
            },
        )

    _run(repo, "fetch", remote, DEV_BRANCH)
    _run(repo, "fetch", remote, MIRROR_BRANCH)

    development_after = _run(
        repo,
        "rev-parse",
        f"{remote}/{DEV_BRANCH}",
    ).stdout.strip()

    mirror_after = _run(
        repo,
        "rev-parse",
        f"{remote}/{MIRROR_BRANCH}",
    ).stdout.strip()

    if development_after != convergence_commit or mirror_after != convergence_commit:
        raise GitGuardError(
            "GIT_CONVERGENCE_POSTCHECK_FAILED",
            {
                "expected": convergence_commit,
                "development": development_after,
                "mirror": mirror_after,
            },
        )

    parents = _run(
        repo,
        "show",
        "-s",
        "--format=%P",
        convergence_commit,
    ).stdout.strip().split()

    if parents != [development, mirror]:
        raise GitGuardError(
            "GIT_CONVERGENCE_HISTORY_PRESERVATION_FAILED",
            {
                "expected_parents": [development, mirror],
                "actual_parents": parents,
            },
        )

    final_dirty = _status_counts(repo)

    if final_dirty["worktree_dirty"]:
        raise GitGuardError(
            "GIT_WORKTREE_NOT_CLEAN",
            final_dirty,
        )

    return {
        "status": "MERGED_FAST_FORWARD_CONVERGED_PASS",
        "development": development_after,
        "mirror_before": mirror,
        "mirror_after": mirror_after,
        "convergence_commit": convergence_commit,
        "merge_base": merge_base,
        "exclusive_development": exclusive_development,
        "exclusive_mirror": exclusive_mirror,
        "classification": "SYNC",
        "auto_fix_applied": True,
        "force_push": False,
        "reset_used": False,
        "rebase_used": False,
        "history_preserved": True,
        "parents": parents,
        "worktree_clean": True,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from tools.mirror_sync import git_divergence_guard as guard


def run(cwd: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", *args],
        cwd=cwd,
        text=True,
    ).strip()


def test_divergent_dev_mirror_convergence_preserves_both_parents(tmp_path):
    remote = tmp_path / "remote.git"
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"

    subprocess.check_call(["git", "init", "--bare", "-q", str(remote)])
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "clone", "-q", str(remote), str(repo)])

    run(repo, "config", "user.name", "EDARSAHUB Worker")
    run(repo, "config", "user.email", "worker@edarsahub.local")

    (repo / "README.md").write_text("base\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(repo, "add", "README.md")
    run(repo, "commit", "-qm", "base")
    run(repo, "branch", "-M", "Edarsahub_Desarrollo")
    base = run(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")

    run(repo, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo")
    run(repo, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/mirror/emergent-live")

    (repo / "dev.txt").write_text("dev\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(repo, "add", "dev.txt")
    run(repo, "commit", "-qm", "dev")
    development = run(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    run(repo, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo")

    mirror_clone = tmp_path / "mirror"
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "clone", "-q", str(remote), str(mirror_clone)])
    run(mirror_clone, "config", "user.name", "EDARSAHUB Worker")
    run(mirror_clone, "config", "user.email", "worker@edarsahub.local")
    run(mirror_clone, "fetch", "-q", "origin", "mirror/emergent-live")
    run(mirror_clone, "checkout", "-q", "-B", "mirror-test",
        "origin/mirror/emergent-live")
    (mirror_clone / "mirror.txt").write_text("mirror\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(mirror_clone, "add", "mirror.txt")
    run(mirror_clone, "commit", "-qm", "mirror")
    mirror = run(mirror_clone, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    run(mirror_clone, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/mirror/emergent-live")

    run(repo, "fetch", "-q", "origin",
        "Edarsahub_Desarrollo", "mirror/emergent-live")

    result = guard.reconcile_dev_mirror_locked(
        repo,
        job_id="TEST-CONVERGENCE",
        owner="universal-worker",
        expected_development=development,
        expected_mirror=mirror,
        expected_base=base,
        expected_file_sha256={
            "dev.txt": hashlib.sha256(
                b"dev\n"
            ).hexdigest(),
            "mirror.txt": hashlib.sha256(
                b"mirror\n"
            ).hexdigest(),
        },
    )

    assert result["status"] == "MERGED_FAST_FORWARD_CONVERGED_PASS"
    assert result["history_preserved"] is True
    assert result["force_push"] is False
    assert result["reset_used"] is False
    assert result["rebase_used"] is False

    final_dev = run(repo, "rev-parse",
        "refs/remotes/origin/Edarsahub_Desarrollo")
    final_mirror = run(repo, "rev-parse",
        "refs/remotes/origin/mirror/emergent-live")

    assert final_dev == final_mirror
    parents = run(repo, "show", "-s", "--format=%P", final_dev).split()
    assert parents == [development, mirror]


def test_convergence_blocks_real_content_conflict(tmp_path):
    remote = tmp_path / "remote.git"
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"

    subprocess.check_call(["git", "init", "--bare", "-q", str(remote)])
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "clone", "-q", str(remote), str(repo)])

    run(repo, "config", "user.name", "EDARSAHUB Worker")
    run(repo, "config", "user.email", "worker@edarsahub.local")

    (repo / "same.txt").write_text("base\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(repo, "add", "same.txt")
    run(repo, "commit", "-qm", "base")
    run(repo, "branch", "-M", "Edarsahub_Desarrollo")
    base = run(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    run(repo, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo")
    run(repo, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/mirror/emergent-live")

    (repo / "same.txt").write_text("dev\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(repo, "commit", "-qam", "dev")
    development = run(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    run(repo, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo")

    mirror_clone = tmp_path / "mirror"
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "clone", "-q", str(remote), str(mirror_clone)])
    run(mirror_clone, "config", "user.name", "EDARSAHUB Worker")
    run(mirror_clone, "config", "user.email", "worker@edarsahub.local")
    run(mirror_clone, "fetch", "-q", "origin", "mirror/emergent-live")
    run(mirror_clone, "checkout", "-q", "-B", "mirror-test",
        "origin/mirror/emergent-live")
    (mirror_clone / "same.txt").write_text("mirror\n", encoding="utf-8")
    run(mirror_clone, "commit", "-qam", "mirror")
    mirror = run(mirror_clone, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    run(mirror_clone, "push", "-q", "origin",
        "HEAD:refs/heads/mirror/emergent-live")

    run(repo, "fetch", "-q", "origin",
        "Edarsahub_Desarrollo", "mirror/emergent-live")

    try:
        guard.reconcile_dev_mirror_locked(
            repo,
            job_id="TEST-CONFLICT",
            owner="universal-worker",
            expected_development=development,
            expected_mirror=mirror,
            expected_base=base,
        )
    except guard.GitGuardError as exc:
        assert exc.code == "GIT_DIVERGENCE_CONFLICT"
    else:
        raise AssertionError("conflict was not blocked")


def test_exact_current_history_and_usuarios_content():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    current = run(root, "rev-parse", "origin/Edarsahub_Desarrollo")
    mirror = run(root, "rev-parse", "origin/mirror/emergent-live")

    assert current == mirror

    required = (
        "bd7aa05ed908898f4e35f22d45b7b2880d7cf17a",
        "d1f139347738f2d627c8d25ca10c694e7565a770",
        "2e2fbcf3d57dc89b3c6e9738453fb4fbfc981a86",
    )

    for commit in required:
        assert run(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", commit, current) == ""

    content = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "show", f"{current}:frontend/src/pages/Usuarios.js"],
        cwd=root,
    )

    assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() == (
        "f040610860c8e2028ec1de2c9c5223c9dc1a36d7e9da15ad04044345c686f55f"
    )
